integrity: The complete public preprint of the classical Bogdanov-map article was inspected through the map derivation, fixed-point linearization, Hopf sign convention, area-preserving limit, mode-locking, and chaos discussion, with document-wide searches for moment, variance, covariance, invariant-measure, and average terminology. A later quadratic-map study was checked for explicit inclusion of the Bogdanov family and for its dynamical-systems classification. Published semantic searches covered stationary covariance, moments, variance, fixed-point-strip geometry, and period-two equality. The mean law, covariance identity, parameter shell, excursion consequence, and equality rigidity were reconstructed independently, and their algebra was replayed with the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem constrains first and second stationary moments and does not determine invariant densities, entropy, Lyapunov exponents, or basin geometry.
The strict fixed-point-strip excursion uses the parameter orientation \(k>0\), \(\mu<0\); the covariance identity itself is parameter-independent.
The covariance-bound equality theorem detects period-at-most-two dynamics but does not classify or prove stability of all two-cycles.
The journal article predates the checked preprint, but no earlier day-resolved public full-text date was used.
A differently phrased equivalent short stationary-moment identity could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Exact covariance geometry and fixed-point-strip excursion in the Bogdanov map
